transcript:
Council Rooms
May the 2d 1870. 7½ Oclock P.M.
Council met pursuant to adjournment. His Honor Leander Barnes Mayor in the Chair. Roll
called, and following Aldermen answered to their Names
Aldermen Bennett, Baker, Raven, Demshke
Collins and Fox
Minutes of the last meeting, read
and adopted
Sextons monthly Report received
and adopted
The Reports of the Mayor and City
Assessor and Collector and Treasurer were received, and passed to Finance Committee

The following Petition to the Legislature was introduced by Alderman Baker, received and
filed.
Bill of S.N. Farr was presented
for five months services as Marshal, was upon motion of Alderman Raven adopted
The following appropriations were made
Mayors Salary ending the 30th of April 1870 $125.00 Rent for City Council 45.00 Assessor
Collector ending 30th of April 1870 125.00 City Attorney 25.00 City Sexton 25.00 Policeman
Henricks for the month of April 1870 40.00 Do Atty do do 40.00 Do Fletcher " " 44.00 John
Pierson taken care of Engine for April 6.00
R. Platt for feeding Prisoners
Judgement in favor of J.M. Blackwell U.S. currency 120.00 Costs of suit in A.S. Currency
37.35 Printing done at the Journals Office 81.00 Alexander Earns work done Cemetery 18.00
Account of Baker & Raymond 3.25 The above appropriations were made by $704.26 the
following Vote Alderman Bennett,
Baker, Demshke, Collins, Fox and Raven
City Council then adjourned
A O Horse
Recorder
